overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by holding its August 10, 2020 meeting without real-time public access, since it did not show economic hardship and best efforts; it ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's August 10 meeting, closed to the public during COVID-19, was held without real-time public access; audio was posted only afterward.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide real-time access to the August 10 meeting without showing that the inability to provide real-time access to the meeting was despite best efforts and due to economic hardship.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
